description: Checksum validation is what separates a real identifier from a number with the right shape. Each pair is one value that passes its checksum and must be detected, beside one that matches the same pattern and fails, which must not be. This is why detectors carry validators rather than length-based patterns.

slots.name: cardInvalid
slots.label: payment_card
slots.note: Card shape, correct length, fails Luhn on the final digit. A regex-only matcher flags it; a validating one does not.
